notes: Widgets, Rainmeter-style: a clock, live system stats (CPU, RAM, disk, battery, network, uptime) and your own text, drawn over the wallpaper and under your icons. Two styles: Mond (big spaced day name with the date and time underneath; uses Anurati and Quicksand if installed) and Panel (translucent cards with bars). Menu bar -> Widgets -> Arrange on desktop to drag them around, scroll to resize, right-click to hide. Settings has a new Widgets pane.
